problem.title: KISS-ICP KITTI Odom seq 00 full: elevation correction and upstream configuration
problem.question: Upstream KISS-ICP corrects the KITTI HDL-64E elevation angle by +0.205 deg in its KITTI loader and the paper reports KITTI-corrected results; the repository runs used raw scans. How much of the paper-number gap does the correction explain?

variants.label: balanced (default) + KITTI 0.205 deg elevation correction
variants.intent: Same variant with the HDL-64E +0.205 deg elevation correction applied to every scan before downsampling.

variants.label: dense profile
variants.intent: Table 6 best variant on seq 00 (raw scans).

variants.label: dense profile + KITTI 0.205 deg elevation correction
variants.intent: Same variant with the HDL-64E +0.205 deg elevation correction applied to every scan before downsampling.

variants.label: upstream KISS-ICP 1.3.0 configuration
variants.intent: Match the upstream defaults (voxel 1.0, 20 pts/voxel, threshold 2.0, 500 iterations at 1e-4, 27-voxel search, 1.5x registration subsample, no point cap).

variants.label: upstream KISS-ICP 1.3.0 configuration + KITTI 0.205 deg elevation correction
variants.intent: Same variant with the HDL-64E +0.205 deg elevation correction applied to every scan before downsampling.

variants.label: upstream configuration + 100 m loader range
variants.intent: Upstream keeps returns up to 100 m; the shared loader drops them beyond 80 m. Does the cap explain the remaining gap to upstream on corrected scans?

variants.label: upstream configuration + 100 m loader range + KITTI 0.205 deg elevation correction
variants.intent: Same variant with the HDL-64E +0.205 deg elevation correction applied to every scan before downsampling.
